claim_one_line: THE AGY LANE'S RELAY ON THE REGISTER-TO-FIELD JOIN, SCRUTINISED AT THE OWNER'S WORD (P-753; before anything of WP-2.2 or WP-3.2 is banked): where main can test the relay it is right -- ten of its claims verified by main's own computation, none found wrong: every move keeps the odd spin structure and the trivial character and permutes the three non-trivial sign characters; one background's pair of lines has an orbit of three and a stabiliser of index 3; the two coherent lifts are one choice (in E8, -1 of SU(4) is -1 of Spin(10), on all 240 roots) and neither is kept by every move, so main's exploratory note in the programme is WITHDRAWN; on main's triplet the moves generate a group of order 96 with scalars of order 4 and projective image S4, S^4 = -1, so it is a module of the double cover that does not factor through SL(2, Z); among the 24 twists of the symmetric square of the level-2 doublet it is the odd twist chi_15 alone, and no even twist has order 96 (24, 48, 72, 144); it is the modular representation of the conjugate of (theta_2^2, theta_3^2, theta_4^2)/eta^3, by two monomial matrices of eighth roots. Main adds two things the relay does not say: the triplet IS a symmetric square over the braid group, of a doublet on a further double cover, and projectively of the level-2 doublet; and the lanes' one-form triplet induced over the three backgrounds (a group of order 24) is the weave's triplet after one odd character, chi_9 -- one projective representation. Not verified, the lane's: which mode of its operator carries which character, the splitting on one background, the table over 248 dimensions. WP-2.2 and WP-3.2 stay open, each with a sharper question; for the join it is whether that odd character is physical. [Added the same evening, § 6: the physical lane reviewed the same relay on its own and reaches the same decision; its finding that the relay's inserted one-form matrices carry the signs (-1, -1) and not the stated (-1, +1) is verified exactly by main, so the odd character is chi_21 for the matrices and chi_9 for the stated signs, the same projective action either way; kept by every move is a fixed-point statement and not a selection; the two subgroups meet E8 through a quotient by Z_4; main's group orders recomputed in exact arithmetic.] 0 of 19.
